meta.name: to-tickets
meta.description: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker — edges as text in one file per ticket locally, or native blocking links on a real tracker.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把计划或讨论拆成可追踪的工单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需将需求或讨论转化为可执行的工单
copy.tagline_en: Break plans or discussions into trackable tickets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn requirements or discussions into actionable tickets

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能把计划、规格或当前对话拆成一组垂直切片的任务票据,每张标明被哪些前置票据阻塞,并发布到已配置的追踪器(本地文件或真实追踪系统)。
howto.when: 当你要求把计划、规格或对话拆解成一套带依赖关系的任务票据时触发。若未配置追踪器,需先运行 /setup-matt-pocock-skills。

say.text: 把这份产品计划拆成票据,写明每张被谁阻塞。
say.note: Claude 会先给出待确认的票据清单。

say.text: 把当前对话里的任务改成垂直切片票据。
say.note: 会基于对话内容生成带依赖的票据。

say.text: 把票据发布到本地文件。
say.note: 会在 .scratch 下按依赖顺序生成每张一个文件。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of vertical-slice tickets, each declaring which tickets block it, and publish them to the configured tracker (local files or a real issue tracker).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to turn a plan, spec, or conversation into a set of tickets with dependencies. A prior run of /setup-matt-pocock-skills is expected to configure the tracker.

say_en.text: Break this product plan into tickets, noting what blocks each one.
say_en.note: Claude will draft a ticket list for you to review.

say_en.text: Turn the current conversation into vertical-slice tickets.
say_en.note: It will generate tickets with dependencies from the conversation.

say_en.text: Publish the tickets as local files.
say_en.note: Writes one file per ticket under .scratch, in dependency order.
